title: Uwell Viscore Blueberry Sour Raspberry Pod & Refill - 20mg
description: The Uwell Viscore Prefilled Pod & Refill in Blueberry Sour Raspberry delivers a delightful blend of sweet blueberries and tangy sour raspberries, creating a bold and refreshing vape. Designed for the Uwell Viscore 8000 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit, this pack features a 2ml prefilled pod and a 10ml refill container, offering exceptional value and convenience. Equipped with a 0.8ohm mesh coil, the pod provides smooth vapour and vibrant flavour, making it perfect for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping. The refill container ensures easy top-ups, extending the pod's usability for up to 8000 puffs, depending on personal usage. Preloaded with 20mg/ml nicotine salt e-liquid, the pod delivers a smooth throat hit and rapid nicotine absorption, ideal for adult vapers seeking a long-lasting and satisfying vaping experience. Replace the pod and refill container when empty to continue enjoying the fruity, tangy Blueberry Sour Raspberry flavour.
